notes: Chance of moving: a ridge logistic regression on our own movement history (NBA box scores and did-not-play lists since 1997: who was listed for which team on which date), refitted each season and validated on held-out seasons (Model page). ESPN's transaction list covers only the last two years, so the history is inferred from the box scores.

Traded or claimed: a move straight to another team (listed there within three weeks) before the deadline. A trade and a waiver claim cannot be told apart without transactions. Leaves: the first team he is listed for next season is not this one, or he is not listed at all.

No contract data: salaries, contract years, options and no-trade clauses are not used, because no source whose terms allow our use has them. Free agency is inferred from age, years since the debut, tenure and role.
Snapshot: the opening rosters; every feature is from earlier seasons.
Value is Hardwood WAR, the last two seasons blended 3:2. Positions are pools: guards, forwards, centres.

Outlook: the chance of adding at least one player at the position who was on another team at the snapshot, from a Poisson model of past arrivals (need there, team strength and trajectory, turnover, expected departures). Draft picks, two-way call-ups and signings from outside the league are not counted.

Targets: players on other teams who would upgrade the team's weakest regular slot in the pool (its second guard or forward, its centre), ranked by their chance of joining: the chance he moves x the chance this team is where he goes (a conditional logit on past moves). An estimate from on-field value and history, not news.
